name: reactzyme_native_support_adaptation_v1
purpose: Determine how much ReactZyme-native test-entity decontamination the current RDKit+ dual-tower can absorb without materially degrading its clean internal capabilities. External ReactZyme test objects define exclusion entities only; no ReactZyme metric is allowed in model/policy selection.

data_isolation.selection_support: existing clean2023 strict protein+reaction double-cold folds 0/1/2 only
data_isolation.reactzyme_test_objects_role: entity exclusion and native-input compatibility definition only
forbidden_selection_sources: previously revealed ReactZyme projected outer metrics

protection_semantics.enzyme_safe: Take tuple[1] protein sequences from ReactZyme enzyme_smi_split/positive_test_seq_smi.pt, normalize whitespace/case/trailing stop, map by exact sequence to the frozen general protein library, and remove every matching protein_id from training.
protection_semantics.union_safe_max: Apply enzyme_safe plus: take tuple[0] molecule bags from ReactZyme reaction_smi_split/positive_test_mol_smi.pt; replace author-style '*' placeholders by C, sort dot-separated components; match exact normalized bags to uniprot_molecules.tsv; collect all RHEA IDs associated with every matched Entry in uniprot_rhea.tsv; remove every training pair whose reaction_id is in that conservative all-RHEA set.
protection_semantics.priority_meaning: Choose the first policy in this fixed order that passes all retention guards. Do not rank passing policies by their measured score.

training_recipe.baseline: exact 3139-d RDKit+ clean2023 recipe used by results/enzymecage_cleanroom_rdkitplus_v1/fold{0,1,2}

retention_evaluation.per_fold_stability: For each fold and each direction on all queries, MRR and MAP may not regress by more than 0.005 absolute.
retention_evaluation.metric_definition: Use the repository query-level columns and the same aggregation as broad_rhea_metrics.summarize_query_metrics: arithmetic mean for reciprocal_rank/average_precision/roc_auc/ndcg/hit columns and median for best_positive_rank.

decision.if_union_passes: select union_safe_max and freeze it before any external ReactZyme scoring
decision.if_union_fails_and_enzyme_passes: select enzyme_safe and freeze it before any external ReactZyme scoring
decision.if_both_fail: retain unchanged current model; do not relax protection or retention thresholds using these fold results
